deploy-bot: Candidate RC created — rc-20260321-74
- author: @maria
- artifacts: serving:v2.4.1 (sha:abc123)
- rollout_mode: staggered
Requesting originate + pin for promo window 12:30-13:15 PST. /link <https://ci.redwood/candidates/rc-20260321-74>

maria: Originate request: cuts from main @ sha-abc123. No DB migrations.
Change window noted 12:30-13:15 PST. QA smoke planned 11:45 PST. Please ack pin and surge.

sam: Acked. No infra changes from my team. Can we set surge capacity +25% for first 10m?

maria: Yes, +25% for 10m. Also enable cache-preload for prefix caches before cut (preload at 12:20).

olivia: QA will run smoke (tag=qa-smoke/v2) at 11:45 and post results here. Expect ~2m run.

jordan: I'll watch latency dashboards and have a short-circuit toggle ready. @sheriff-ryan can you own sheriff for this promo?

sheriff-ryan: I can take sheriff from 12:15-13:30. set pager to +1. I'll be standing by.

sam: Rollback plan: revert to serving:v2.4.0 (sha:abc122) and flip `feature_x` flag off. I have rollback playbook at /playbooks/rollback-rc.md

maria: Pin in queue please. Also set staged rollout: 10%->30%->100% over 30m with 5m gaps. Traffic cushion +10% headroom.

engops-bot: Candidate rc-20260321-74 pinned to promo queue by @maria. Preload cache job scheduled at 6423110000 (12:20 PST). Staged rollout policy applied.

maria: OK ready. QA green?

olivia: QA smoke: PASS. No obvious regressions. Logs attached: `smoke.log` (small spike at 1min, cleared).

maria: Triggering promote now: `/deploy promote rc-20260321-74 --to prod --stagger 10,30,100 --gwindow 45m --surge 10% --preload-cache`

deploy-bot: Promote command received. Starting staged rollout. First cohort (10%) created.

deploy-bot: 12:35 PST — Cohort 10% healthy. Latency +3ms, error rate unchanged.

deploy-bot: 12:45 PST — Cohort 30% healthy. No elevated errors. Continuing to 100%.

deploy-bot: 12:55 PST — Promotion to 100% complete. All monitors OK. Closing thread. :tada:

maria: Thanks all. Filing release notes and arch note.
